_readme: Consolidated attribution/licence registry for this repository. Individual data.json files no longer carry licence prose inline; each carries only a 'licence_ref' key pointing to an id here. This file is the single place that text lives. See rewrite_licence_refs.py (repo root) for the migration that created it, and PROVENANCE.md in the parabuddhi sibling repo for the separate, already-planned rights/provenance architecture this extends. Public-domain / no-restriction texts (the majority of this corpus) carry no licence field at all and are not listed here -- there is nothing to attribute.
